allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Kross Limited has informed the Exchange about Allotment of 15,00,000 Equity shares on a Preferential Basis and Allotment of 15,00,000 fully Convertible equity warrants convertible into or exchangeable for One (1) fully paid-up equity share

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Kross Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on October 30, 2026 for Allotment of 15,00,000 Equity shares on a Preferential Basis and Allotment of 15,00,000 fully Convertible equity warrants convertible into or exchangeable for One (1) fully paid-up equity share

allot.subject: Issue of Securities
allot.text: Kross Limited has informed the Exchange about Board of the directors at their meeting held today i.e. 31st August 2026 has considered and approved the Preferential Issue details are submitted
